supersedes: Only broad sequencing in the external 2026-10-10 advisory checkpoint; preserves P0-P11/C1-C12 identities, existing contracts, queue authority and historical evidence.

relationship_semantics.implementation_prerequisites: Only capability outputs needed to implement this increment; an empty list does not authorize effects.
relationship_semantics.activation_gates: Capability prerequisites before operational use, plus the named exact task/effect authority and profile.
relationship_semantics.qualification_gates: Evidence needed before support, release, reliability or efficiency claims; source presence alone is insufficient.
relationship_semantics.preferred_sequence: Ordering or shared opportunity only; never an admission blocker.

capabilities.title: Accurate current version, task and evidence view
capabilities.existing_owner: C1/C8; existing release, task/status and Reconciler
acceptance: Published Lite and current source remain distinct.
Historical records are dated; implemented, qualified, supported, released and used are separate dimensions.

capabilities.title: One actual host and route inventory
acceptance: Observe exact tool/runtime/host identities once.
Old negative evidence is preserved and never inherited across subjects.

capabilities.title: Useful edit/check/collect/retire through one selected route
acceptance: Actual enabled editing/read/shell routes meet the named profile or remain excluded.
Exact finite admission, pause, recovery and synthetic excluded-path probes precede claimed protected operation.
An unchanged unsupported route is dormant; independent authorized work continues.

capabilities.title: One target-owned downstream ordinary repository task
capabilities.existing_owner: Selected target queue; released Lite distribution owner
acceptance: Target authority, ownership and actual local Lite prerequisites are satisfied independently.
Preserve customization, authored content and existing tools.
Supervised/read-only consumption does not require optional whole-session containment.

capabilities.title: Portable same-WorkUnit continuation
acceptance: Retain effects, uncertainty, remaining obligations, decisions and budgets.
Another session resumes without duplicate completed effects or hidden provider history.

capabilities.title: Loss-aware readers and required-semantics refusal
acceptance: Safe unfamiliar optional information round-trips.
Unknown required execution semantics refuse; actual writer/migration guarantees are separately qualified.

capabilities.title: Cooperating-project admission and per-checkout ownership
acceptance: Heavy-job admission, checkout mutation ownership and shared-service request ownership are distinct.
Hard, monitored, cooperative and unsupported limits are explicit.
Unenrolled agents remain outside enforcement.

capabilities.title: Independent logical request cancellation
acceptance: Cancelling one fixture request preserves another.
Actual shared inference activation requires its own supported binding and resource authority.

capabilities.title: Whole-outcome cost observation from the first useful task
acceptance: Record preparation, context/transfer, execution, tests, review, repair, integration, recovery and cleanup.
Unknown accounting is null/classified unknown; failed/cancelled attempts remain included.
Avoid double-counting cumulative/shared counters.

capabilities.title: Matched accepted-outcome efficiency comparison
acceptance: Match task, quality, recipe and relevant environment.
Report correctness, human effort, continuity, accepted-outcome latency, resources, known usage and duplication.
Child-only token savings do not establish whole-outcome savings.

capabilities.title: Answer one concrete owner/helper/test question
capabilities.existing_owner: C1/C8; existing inventory, quality, context and knowledge producers
acceptance: Explain selection by task target, interface, caller, regression, decision, failure or ownership constraint.
Distinguish not-selected, known-absent, not-found, unindexed and stale.
Use existing facts before adding semantic producers.

capabilities.title: Selective, cheap work conservation
acceptance: Promote a useful regression/helper only where actual reuse warrants it.
Keep source-linked failure lessons and diagnostic value; retire established disposable scratch.
Shared fixtures/transport do not replace an independent semantic oracle.

capabilities.title: Conservative incremental impact and test selection
capabilities.existing_owner: ProjectGraph producer/consumer and existing test owners
acceptance: Incomplete dependencies broaden checks.
Compare selection against known cases and retain missed regressions.
Cross-machine consistency and automatic restructuring remain separate, unadmitted capabilities.

capabilities.title: One narrow adapter role reference and conformance fixture
acceptance: Declare effects, cancellation, storage and unsupported/lost semantics.
Fixture conformance is narrower than live operational conformance.

capabilities.title: Interchangeable real execution bindings
acceptance: One deterministic route and two materially different authorized bindings preserve task semantics.
Model, account, descendant effort and effect authority remain independent controls.

capabilities.title: Read-only Workbench work/context/evidence projection
capabilities.existing_owner: Existing host contract and Dominium Workbench owners
acceptance: Show existing identities and evidence with permission-aware reads.
No live worker, domain apply or second task authority is implied.

capabilities.title: Bounded legacy/offline task-result interchange proof
acceptance: Export/inspect a finite task-result bundle with identities and loss/refusal semantics.
Full IDE support and L0-L4 parity are not inferred.

capabilities.title: One native domain preview/apply/validate/recovery workflow
capabilities.existing_owner: Domain-owned capabilities, Dominium bridge and native host
acceptance: Exact domain authority, qualified mutation/recovery operations and actual host route precede activation.
Preview, stale-write refusal, post-apply validation and domain recovery have independent evidence.
Two interchangeable coding backends and a full ProjectGraph are not blanket prerequisites.

capabilities.title: Fenced networked work and recovery
capabilities.existing_owner: Existing durable-state owners and replaceable transport/store bindings
acceptance: Node identity, current ownership generations, stale-worker rejection and durable cancellation.
Partition/reconnect, uncertain effects and restoration are proven for an exact profile.

capabilities.title: Source-linked lesson correction and retirement
acceptance: Applicability and confidentiality remain scoped.
Retirement invalidates dependent retrieval; no automatic authority or evaluator rewrite.

capabilities.title: Optional governed model adaptation
acceptance: Lineage, license/data authority, held-out evaluator, activation and rollback precede a learned-improvement claim.
Training and routing-policy changes are independently admitted effects.

capabilities.title: Managed packages, Commander and scale profiles
acceptance: Signing/versioning, migration/revocation, tenant boundaries and restore/scale evidence.
Marketplace/fleet distribution does not block a first contributor fixture or Lite release.

phases.positive: Task context identifies the intended outcome, existing owner/helper, relevant checks and permitted effects.
phases.refusal: Missing or stale facts remain explicit; the graph cannot widen authority.
phases.recovery: Source identities and selection reasons can be reconstructed without the full conversation.

phases.positive: A useful bounded change uses the actual selected editing route.
phases.refusal: Excluded synthetic reads/writes are denied for the claimed profile; unsupported routes refuse.
phases.recovery: A stopped attempt retains its proposal and does not imply applied effects.

phases.positive: Registered checks retain outcomes, failures, skips and source/environment identities.
phases.refusal: A missing required check cannot become PASS; unknown impact broadens validation.
phases.recovery: Collected check receipts survive interruption and are reused only while dependencies match.

phases.positive: A controlled interruption identifies finished, unfinished and uncertain effects.
phases.refusal: Uncertain effects are never treated as absent or successful by inference.
phases.recovery: Original attempt and failure records remain immutable.

phases.positive: Another session continues the same WorkUnit from a portable checkpoint.
phases.refusal: Changed source/route invalidates affected evidence; a stale owner cannot act.
phases.recovery: Known completed effects are not repeated; uncertainty is reconciled before retry.

phases.positive: A useful regression, helper, explanation or failed hypothesis is discoverable.
phases.refusal: Unknown ownership blocks disposal; an experiment is not automatically a public tool.
phases.recovery: Unique value is preserved before owned scratch is retired.

phases.positive: One target-owned ordinary repository task preserves policy, tools and customization.
phases.refusal: AIDE adoption does not grant device effects or target release authority.
phases.recovery: Target receipts and recovery remain target-owned.

phases.positive: One compact view shows outcome, evidence, limitations, usage and the next action.
phases.refusal: Inspection does not mutate, bill, dispatch or repeatedly wake a model.
phases.recovery: The view is reconstructible from canonical records, with unknown coverage visible.

proof_levels.feasibility: One useful AIDE task and one target-owned consumer journey with honest boundaries.
proof_levels.repeatability: A repeated journey plus a controlled failure/recovery case under declared inputs.
proof_levels.supported_profile: Only after exact required checks and independent review for the named profile.

resource_ownership: one mutation owner per mutable checkout/resource partition
finite heavy-job admission among cooperating consumers
logical request ownership separate from shared server lifetime
cross_cutting.waiting: Existing finite observer; one terminal result; no unchanged resubmission or model polling.

release.required_predecessor: actual published 1.0.0 with customization, direct edits, conflict/resolution and supported recovery
